title: Pitwall message envelope
description: Every message on the bus uses this envelope. The event-specific payload lives under `data` and is validated against its own schema based on `type` + `schemaVersion`.

id.description: Unique per message. Used by the idempotent inbox to dedupe.

schemaVersion.description: Bumped only on a breaking change to the data payload.

occurredAt.description: RFC3339 UTC time the fact happened.

correlationId.description: Created once at the start of a flow and copied onto every downstream event.

causationId.description: Id of the message that directly caused this one. Null for flow-originating events.

data.description: Event-specific payload; validated against the schema for `type` + `schemaVersion`.
